status: Proposed exact interface for root agreement; not admitted proof or runtime acceptance.

conditions: Server family proof binds this actual marker to this exact datum anchor; distinct actual marker qid is later in DOM than the source curve.
Only the source datum curve obligation can use the marker; no other datum/category/value borrows it.
The entire target boundary native-alpha footprint is covered by this marker's native alpha and independently original contributing marker paint; a nonempty intersection alone is insufficient.
The source target retains its whole isolated native-alpha denominator and exact owned overlap accounting; altered foreign paint, hidden marker, or unknown glyph/primitive measurement cannot pass.
marker.maskBasis: Target native alpha. Footprint is target boundary intersect marker native alpha; originalContribution also intersects marker original contribution. Both must cover the whole target boundary footprint, with independent marker original contribution.

conditions: Alternative only for an exact adjacent stack seam already proved contiguous with a common scale, category, axis and unit; it does not exempt the whole datum.

Both complete numeric/unit labels have unique actual segment ownership assigned before number comparison; boundary-centered ambiguous labels, another category's label, title or axis text cannot substitute.

Both exact bound values and units are checked against the independently proved datum geometry; every required glyph character must have actual original contribution and complete font/material evidence.
Both declared interior-profile contribution regions have independent actual contribution; no glyph or neighboring datum substitutes for either region.

The category stack's actual first baseline and last outer-total boundaries terminate in original-boundary-contribution or the exact calibrated-value-line witness; no recursive bound-stack-value-glyphs support.

Visible series-name/order association remains separately required; identical legend swatches alone do not prove series ownership. Missing, hidden, swapped, repeated or extra labels and distorted source geometry remain strict.
stackValueGlyphs.rendererWitnessFields: Exact echo of the selected manifest alternative plus targetId and supportId. The consumer separately resolves every referenced actual glyph target, contribution-region measurement and baseline/total boundary witness; no summary boolean authorizes support.
